name: Uninstall bar
what: A system-style dialog pops in: "Uninstalling doomscrolling…" with a striped progress bar filling in stutters, a spinner and a status line. It hangs at 99 %, says Not responding, and the whole frame breaks apart - the dialog glitches with it (slices shifting, an RGB split) and collapses to a line at the very end.
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: f0-f9 the dialog pops in from 80 % (slow end, a small overshoot, seen within 3 f); from 0.2 s the bar fills in stutters to 97 % by 2.4 s (fast runs on S-curves, short stalls: 8, 11, 34, 36, 62, 64, 88, 97 %), its stripes moving and the spinner turning, the status line changing (Preparing…, Removing files…, Cleaning up…, Almost done…); at 2.5 s (f75) it hangs at 99 %, the status turns red (Not responding) and the companion glitch starts: on more and more frames (35 % at first, 95 % at the end) the dialog jitters, its 7 slices shift sideways and an RGB fringe splits its edges and title, all ramping (^1.6) to the end; the last 4 f it collapses to a bright line (accelerating) and is gone. The timing is in seconds: the break stays at 2.5 s at any length

tracks.name: progress
tracks.what: the bar fills in stutters to 97 %

tracks.name: break
tracks.what: it hangs at 99 % and glitches more and more (slices, RGB split, jitter)

tracks.name: collapse
tracks.what: the dialog collapses to a bright line and is gone

min_why: the bar fills until 2.4 s and the break (the companion glitch) starts at 2.5 s; it needs a moment of breaking after that
